name: A busy half hour keeps Boop lively without flailing
judge: A realistic busy half hour of quick turns, a failing build that gets fixed, and a long quiet turn. Boop should feel alive throughout without flailing.
reasonable: Frequent, varied reactions, most finishes noticed, voice fairly often. Mood moving a few times: put out at the failure, up at the fix or long finish, easing between.
unreasonable: Long blank stretches, the same face over and over, moods bouncing back and forth, huge moments at routine wins, or a flat long finish.
